{{Quote|Admiral, we have enemy ships in Sector 47.''"<br />"''It's a trap!|Verrack and Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
'''Sector 47''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were located in Sector 47 and ambushed the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack]]<ref name="Customizable Card Game">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Verrack}}</ref> informed [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] about the location of the Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Admiral, we have enemy ships at Sector RT-23 and PB-4.''"<br />"''It's a trap. Prepare for attack.|Verrack and Gial Ackbar|<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Sector 47 was not mentioned in the [[1983]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. Instead, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Controller/Legends|controller]] mentions [[Sector RT-23]] and [[Sector PB-4]].<ref name="ROTJ novel" />
